rows.corpus_definition: The specific city or country where a person was born.
rows.example_en: He returned to the town where he was born.

rows.corpus_definition: Having a sharp and unpleasant taste like black coffee.
rows.example_en: This medicine has a very bitter taste.

rows.corpus_definition: a person whose job is making and repairing metal objects
rows.example_en: The blacksmith hammered the hot iron into a horseshoe.

rows.corpus_definition: to say that someone is responsible for a bad event or mistake
rows.example_en: Do not blame me for your own mistake.

rows.corpus_definition: To mix two or more things together.
rows.example_en: Blend the fruit and milk together well.

rows.corpus_definition: To ask for good things to happen to someone.
rows.example_en: The priest arrived to bless the new house.

rows.corpus_definition: To open and close the eyes very quickly.
rows.example_en: Don't blink or you will miss it.
The garden flowers begin to bloom in spring.

rows.corpus_definition: when flowers open on a plant, or to develop and grow well
rows.example_en: The cherry trees blossom beautifully every spring.

rows.corpus_definition: to talk too proudly about what you have or can do
rows.example_en: He always boasts about his high exam scores.
